name: XDKNet 2.4.13
body:
Android TV 2.4.13, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.0.9.2 (Emby 2.0.4.2).

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

This release fixes playback that could stay on loading after pressing Play,
and web pages that failed to load while the server was busy.

## Playback on Android TV

- **Theme music no longer blocks playback.** Pressing Play while a title's
  theme song was still starting could stop anything from playing until the
  app was closed and reopened. The theme now stops at once in that case, and
  nothing waits on it for more than a few seconds.
- **A start that fails says so.** When the server is too busy to answer, the
  player used to stay on "Loading Stream..." for good, and Play on a title's
  page looked like it did nothing. Both now show that the title could not be
  played, with a Retry.
- **Stalled starts end.** A stream that makes no progress for a minute now
  stops with an error instead of buffering for up to ten minutes.
- **Slow subtitles no longer hold up the picture.** When the server has to
  extract a subtitle from a large file first, the video now starts without
  waiting for it. A subtitle that takes too long is asked for again in the
  background and appears once the server has it, instead of stalling
  playback for minutes.
- **Short intros move on to the film.** Cinema-mode intros shorter than about
  five seconds used to stop on their last frame.
- **Previews and theme music can't stop the film.** A trailer preview or a
  late theme song could stop a film that had just started, leaving a black
  screen.
- **Video after music plays.** Starting a video while music played in the
  background could leave the player on a black frame at 0:00.
- **Leaving a title while it starts.** Going back while a start was still
  running used to leave the item playing with nothing on screen. It now stops.

## Loading

- **Rows don't disappear.** A home row whose request timed out used to vanish
  until home was fully reloaded. It now keeps what it shows and loads again by
  itself shortly after.
- **Title pages on a busy server.** A title page tries its request once more
  before giving up, and shows a plain "Failed to load" with Retry instead of a
  technical error.
- **Less background traffic.** A title's page stops looking through the
  server's collections while another page is open on top of it, and remembers
  what it found for ten minutes.
- If the server couldn't be reached for a moment, the app now checks again on
  its own instead of waiting for the network to change.

## System Monitor

**Settings > About > System Monitor** gains a **Network** section: how many
requests to the server are waiting right now, how long the last minute's took,
and the last few that failed. The monitor is now also in the web app.

## Web app (plugin 2.0.9.2)

- Pages and rows no longer fail with "connection timeout" while the browser
  waits for a free connection to a busy server.
- The home screen loads fewer rows at once when the browser can only open a
  few connections to the server, as it did before 2.4.11, and no longer
  reloads everything each time the window regains focus.
- The System Monitor is available under Settings > About, with the browser's
  memory, request timings, frame timing and storage use.

Pair with plugin 2.0.9.2.
